tools.purpose: Parse a CryptoAPI PUBLICKEYBLOB (bitlen, exponent, little-endian modulus), then verify a PKCS#1 v1.5 signature over the machine-code payload by real modular exponentiation.
tools.expect: key fields plus a per-encoding table naming the single payload encoding that verifies

notes: Verification is pow(signature, exponent, modulus) with an exact PKCS#1 v1.5 EM comparison, so a passing row is a real signature check. --raw switches to a bare digest compare for clients that skip DigestInfo. The self test generates a throwaway 512-bit key in memory.
